notes.subject: שובבתך
notes.rationale: Root שוב — 'turnim yu i go het' (YLT) o 'bagarapim yu' (KJV 'perverted'); shap bilong tok i 'turn back/away'.

notes.subject: Babel
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tokim olgeta long Babel long dairekt tok — 'yu', 'yu tok', 'bel bilong yu'.

notes.subject: אני ואפסי עוד
notes.rationale: Hibru pasin bilong tok: 'Mi, na i pinis long mi' — tok bilong man i ting em tasol i stap.

translation: Na yu belivim long olgeta ol rong bilong yu; yu tok: 'Sampela i no lukim mi.' Ol save bilong yu na ol save long samting bilong yu — em i stap yet, em i turnim yu i go het; na yu tok long bel bilong yu: 'Mi tasol, na i no gat narapela moa.'
